answer: Fake identities are stopped by sequential time-bound work bound to one key. Each agent must solve unpredictable tasks issued one at a time and sign each answer with the same key before a short deadline. Tasks cannot be batched or solved in advance, and missing windows resets progress. The controls glacier, juniper, and ferrous set the deadline, task entropy, and reset rule. One honest agent does one stream of work, while a Sybil farm must staff every fake in real time, so extra identities add full cost with no shortcut.
